title: AutoPay Service Share on Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Billing-Error Corrections
content:
When Bluegate corrects a protection fee charged in billing error on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, it adds to the correction an AutoPay service credit equal to the service-credit base multiplied by the AutoPay share. The AutoPay share is read from the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization drafts submitted for the covered storage unit rental — the drafts recorded on the AutoPay authorization for that rental — in the 12 whole months before the handling date.

## Schedule

| AutoPay drafts submitted for the covered rental in the 12 whole months before the handling date | AutoPay share |
| --- | --- |
| 12 or more | 0.25 |
| 6 to 11 | 0.1 |
| fewer than 6 | 0 |

## Notes

1. The drafts counted are those submitted for the covered unit rental itself; drafts for a parking agreement or for another unit do not count.
2. The thresholds turn on the count: 12 drafts give 0.25 and 11 give 0.1; 6 drafts give 0.1 and 5 give 0.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A service-credit base of 15.00 and 12 drafts in the look-back give an AutoPay share of 0.25 and an AutoPay service credit of 3.75. With 7 drafts the share is 0.1 and the credit 1.50.
